verses.text: Yahweh told Moses: 📣
‘Set apart for me every firstborn male—the first to open the womb among Israel’s people and animals. They belong to me.’ 👶
Moses told the people, ‘Remember this day—you came out of Egypt, out of slavery. Yahweh brought you out with his mighty hand. Don’t eat bread made with yeast. 🧳
‘You’re leaving today, in the month of Abib. 🗓️

‘When Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites, and Jebusites—the land he swore to give your ancestors, flowing with milk and honey—keep this ceremony during this month. 🗺️
‘Eat unleavened bread for seven days, and on the seventh day hold a feast to Yahweh. 🍞
‘Eat unleavened bread throughout all seven days. Don’t let leavened bread or yeast be seen anywhere in your territory. 🚫
‘On that day, tell your child, “I’m doing this because of what Yahweh did for me when I came out of Egypt.” 👨‍👧
‘Let this be a sign on your hand and a reminder in front of your eyes, so Yahweh’s teaching stays in your mouth. Yahweh brought you out of Egypt with his mighty hand. ✋
‘Keep this rule at its appointed time, year after year. 📅
‘When Yahweh brings you into the Canaanite land, as he promised you and your ancestors, and gives it to you, 🗺️
‘set apart for Yahweh every firstborn male. The firstborn males of your livestock belong to Yahweh too. 🐑
‘Redeem every firstborn donkey with a lamb. If you don’t redeem it, break its neck. Redeem every firstborn son among your children. 🐑
‘When your child later asks, “What does this mean?” tell him, “Yahweh brought us out of Egypt, out of slavery, with his mighty hand. 👨‍👦

“‘“When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, Yahweh killed every firstborn in Egypt, human and animal. That’s why I sacrifice every firstborn male animal to Yahweh, and redeem each firstborn son.”’ ⚠️
‘Let this be a sign on your hand and a reminder in front of your eyes: Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with his mighty hand.’ ✋

When Pharaoh finally let the people go, God didn’t lead them along the Philistine route, even though it was shorter. God thought, ‘If they see war, they might change their minds and go back to Egypt.’ 🧭
So God led the people around through the wilderness toward the Red Sea. Israel’s people left Egypt organized for battle. 🏜️
Moses took Joseph’s bones with him. Joseph had made Israel’s people swear, ‘God will surely come to your aid, and when he does, carry my bones up from here with you.’ 🦴
They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness. 🏕️
Yahweh went ahead of them in a cloud column by day to guide their journey, and in a fire column by night to light the way, so they could travel by day and night. ☁️
The cloud column never left its place ahead of the people by day, and the fire column never left by night. 🔥
